title: Why your smartphone is secretly an AI supercomputer

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your phone can recognize faces, translate languages, and drive cars — all in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is now so powerful, it’s running on your pocket-sized device every single day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your smartphone has a neural engine that processes billions of calculations per second.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses machine learning models like Apple’s Core ML to do tasks you never even ask for.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects how apps work, how fast your phone runs, and even how it understands you.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real power of AI isn’t in the cloud — it’s in your hands, right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how your phone thinks? Tap to follow and I’ll show you.

caption_text: Why your smartphone is secretly an AI supercomputer
